senses.gloss: m. (Inf. Hif. of עָנַק, with ref. to Deut. XV, 14) the outfitting of the emancipated slave.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 17b:3">Kidd. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>לה׳</he> (‘and also to thy handmaid shalt thou do likewise’, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 15:17">Deut. XV, 17</cite>) refers to the outfit (not to the marking of the ear); Y. ib. I, 59ᶜ bot.; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 122">Sifré Deut. 122</cite>.
